comments.author: alice
comments.body:
Please raise on an empty table here instead of returning None.

In general, a reader should fail loudly on input it cannot use: a silent None turns into a wrong number three steps later.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Keep the timeout for this one fetch at 30 s; the upstream archive is slow on Mondays.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: Name the column `flux_w_m2`, not `flux`. Units go in the column name so nobody has to guess them.

comments.author: dana
comments.body: Looks good overall. For future PRs: put the ticket key on the first line of the description, the release notes are built from it.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Thanks all, merging once CI is green.
